ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels localized in the central lobe regions versus 55% low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the leading edges, median notch, and lower fluke boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous blobs: a roughly triangular patch on the left lobe extending from the mid-trailing edge toward the center, and a larger rectangular patch on the right lobe occupying the majority of the lobe's center-to-distal area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 70-80 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; the amplitude of variations increases noticeably as the edge approaches the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature observed along the outer margins of both lobes, culminating in pointed, slightly upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, scattered low-intensity pixel clusters (diameter 3-8 pixels) distributed across the white patch of the left lobe and lower-central region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of dark, unaligned linear disruptions. On the right lobe white patch, 3-4 parallel vertical/diagonal rake marks are clearly visible. The left lobe exhibits multiple thin, intersecting diagonal linear marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical rake marks on the right lobe surface; jagged, irregular pixel boundary at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe suggesting minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific dark, bifurcated 'Y-shaped' marking located near the lower-left edge of the right-lobe white patch.
